pass_a_gloss: These things by me, according to what is possible, with the means by which it was possible, have been dictated to you, which things I pray to become for you useful toward the present struggle. But if you, most of all now, as worthy to see more of the mysteries of God, grasping greater and richer things and more accomplishing toward the thing lying before you than these, as childish and cheap will look down on these, I too would pray for such a thing about you. For there lies before you not the being accomplished through us of the things concerning you, but the being accomplished in whatever way ever. And if only indeed it might be accomplished through more divine and more understanding words, and ones going above all human nature, and wisdom of God.
pass_b_english: These things I have dictated to you as far as I could, with such means as I had, and I pray that they may prove useful to you for the present contest. But if you, now above all, as men worthy to see more of the mysteries of God, grasp things greater and richer than these, and more effective for the task before you, and so despise these as childish and cheap, I too would pray for that on your behalf. For what lies before you is not that your cause should be accomplished through us, but that it should be accomplished somehow. And would that it might be accomplished through words more divine and wiser, surpassing all human nature, and through the wisdom of God.

choices.choice: 2026-11-11: retranslated in full from Koetschau (GCS 2, ch. 51); the old English was a digest: it was close in outline but called the readers 'most worthy now' and read 'these things beside which you shall despise mine', and it closed with an exclamation that the Greek does not have.
'γενέσθαε' read as 'γενέσθαι'; 'εἷς ἄξιοι' as 'ὡς ἄξιοι'; 'οἷς παιδικῶν' as 'ὡς παιδικῶν'; 'di’ ἡμῶν' as 'δι᾽ ἡμῶν'.
'with such means as I had' (literally 'with the things with which it was possible').

source_text: Ταῦτά μοι. κατὰ τὸ δυνατὸν, οἷς οἷόν τε ἦν, πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὑπηγόρευται, ἅπερ εὔχομαι ὑμῖν γενέσϑαε πρὸς τὸν παρόντα ἀγῶνα χρήσιμα. εἰ δ᾽ ὑμεῖς μάλιστα νῦν εἷς ἄξιοι πλείονα βλέπειν τῶν τοῦ ϑεοῦ μυστηρίων μείζονα καὶ πλουσιώτερα καταλαμβάνοντες καὶ πρὸς τὸ προκείμενον ἀνυσιμώτερα τούτων οἷς παιδιχῶν καὶ εὐτελῶν καταφρονήσετε, κἀγὼ ἂν τὸ τοιοῦτον περὶ ὑμῶν εὐξαίμην. πρόκειται γὰρ ὑμῖν οὐ τὸ di’ ἡμῶν ἀνυσϑῆναι τὰ καϑ᾽ ὑμᾶς ἀλλὰ τὸ ὅπως ποτὲ ἀνυσϑῆναι. καὶ εἴϑε γε ἀνυσϑείη διὰ ϑειοτέρων καὶ συνετωτέρων καὶ ὑπερεχόντων πᾶσαν ἀνϑρωπίνην φύσιν λόγων καὶ σοφίας ϑεοῦ.
